pity.title: Pity calculator
pity.intro: Pick the equipment, its current level and your pity counter to see the most you could spend.
pity.counter.hint: Failed attempts accumulated on this upgrade.
pity.assume: Worst-case calculation: probabilities are ignored. With a pity of n, attempt n+1 is a guaranteed success; with counter 0 and pity 3, the maximum is 4 attempts. Steps with no pity or 100% success count as 1 attempt.
support.epicHint: Click the Epic button to copy my creator code and use it at checkout on the Epic Games Store.
pet.title: Pet AFK Arena
pet.intro: Tick the pets you own, how many copies and their level (99 by default). The calculator finds the expedition split that gives the most acorns per day.
pet.rules: Rules used: 3 expedition slots at once; each slot runs one 24 h expedition or two 12 h ones in a row, and they can be repeated with the same team. The same campaign with the same duration can't run twice at once. Max 5 pets per team and a pet can't be in two expeditions at once. The required power is the sum of the power of the pets sent.
pet.none: Tick at least one pet to calculate.
pet.twice: sent twice a day (12 h + 12 h)
pet.nofeasible: With the ticked pets no expedition can be completed. Tick more pets or more copies.
pet.approx: The search was cut short by time: a better split may exist.
pet.tip: Tip: don't tick the pets you don't want to keep busy. Pets on an AFK Arena expedition can't accompany you or be summoned in the Celestial Spire.
pet.tip2: My personal recommendation: Aurus for farming (it gives a 10% buff and tanks), Lumi for TS and expeditions (the single-player mode that you play yourself; it has nothing to do with AFK Arena) and Sleepy Koala for raids. If you want to keep them for those uses, don't tick them in the calculator: a pet on an AFK Arena expedition can't be used in other modes.
spire.intro: Which elements and damage types the enemies on each floor resist, and the rewards each floor gives. The spire has 50 floors.
spire.legend.el: Immune to an element: damage of that element is reduced by 100%, so you deal 1 damage.
spire.legend.ty: Resists a damage type: it has a 35% chance to reduce the damage by 100% (you deal 1). If it doesn't trigger, damage is normal and you one-shot it.
wings.intro: Work out how much you still need to get Paimon's Wings and how long it takes depending on how you play the Celestial Spire.
wings.floor: Floor you're on (the one you're about to clear)
wings.done: You already have the Infinity coin needed for Paimon's Wings.
wings.rest: What you earn from floor {f} to 50
wings.c.total: Total Infinity coin if you finish the spire
wings.after: After finishing the spire you'd still need {n} Infinity coin.
wings.after0: With that you'd already have the Infinity coin for Paimon's Wings.
wings.s1: Daily only: 1 floor a day (3 coin and 3 keys)
wings.s2: + Complete the spire once a month
wings.towers: With full runs only: about {n} runs ({w} counting the roulette).
wings.notes: Approximate calculation: a month is 30 days and one floor a day is assumed for the daily. It doesn't count the monthly ranking reward or repeating the spire several times in the same month.
wings.month: Spire completed this month (monthly achievement already claimed)
wings.title: Paimon's Wings
pet.levelnote: Each pet's power is calculated as max power ÷ 99 × level, without decimals (truncated, as in the game). If you own several copies of a pet, the same level is used for all of them.
tool.raid.name: Raid checklist
tool.raid.desc: What I check before entering a raid.
raid.notice: Not everything is mandatory: this is the list of things I check for myself before entering a raid.
raid.intro: Click each box to tick it. It's only a visual aid: ticks aren't saved, so they disappear if you reload the page.
r.title: Title
r.title.n: Each raid has a suitable one
tool.raidgold.name: Raid gold calculator
tool.raidgold.desc: Work out how much gold you've earned from each raid's items, selling to NPC or on Nosbazar.
rg.intro: Pick the raid, enter how many of each item you got and choose where to sell each one. The gold total is at the bottom.
rg.note: NPC prices are fixed. Nosbazar prices are the ones from the day the calculator was created, so they may have changed: edit them to what each item is worth today. Non-tradable items can only be sold to an NPC.
rg.nt: Not tradable: can only be sold to an NPC
